decision: ACCEPT named math/reset source and explicit compatibility direction; HOLD runtime producer admission pending list membership/position correspondence

staticArtifacts.claims: Only data decoding and pure host integer arithmetic; no original instructions executed/emulated, game model run or browser route.

verified: Canonical PE and decoder identity, all source/artifact hashes and original byte ranges correspond.
Producer window covers exact zero-extended arguments, signed tribe/global predicate, established-base gate, full linked-list maximum, sqrt call, attribute14 and byte write.
PE section mapping independently resolves seed VA0x586034 to file offset1593396; exact first32 bytes match the sixteen declared little-endian words.

Sqrt instructions return0 for input0; otherwise BSR selects a positive seed followed by unsigned division and descending integer Newton updates. Recorded host arithmetic checks all32769 values in the proven domain; this is mathematical evidence, not original execution.

Maintained world-turn/processTribes ordering already calls campaignRules before stepComputerTasks with a radius phase, under existing world/tribe gates. Filling that opportunity does not prove original invocation cadence.
